## Why
The root of track A (`docs/local-first.md` §10). Its children move hkb onto a Node floor of 22.13, delete the Actions runner, put a `Store` seam under the tick, and build the two local tiers (a `kb-board` git branch plus a `node:sqlite` index) behind it. This card is the verify-and-synthesize pass that runs once the leaf (A6) is done.

## What
Do not redo the children's work. Read their results (`hkb show <n> --json` on each of A1–A6; only A6 is your blocker, so name the others by their numbers in this card's comments). Then:
1. Check the pieces fit: the conformance suite runs both drivers; `hkb dispatch --dry-run --json` on this repo's GitHub-backed board is unchanged from before the seam.
2. In a scratch repository (`git init`, one commit, a remote pointing at a bare clone), run `hkb init` on the local store, `hkb create`, `hkb claim --spawn` with the `claude-p` profile (or a manual claim + `hkb finish` if no harness is available), `hkb sync`, and `hkb serve` — and from a second clone of that remote, `hkb serve` shows the board read-only.
3. Write what no child could: the wiki page `concepts/store.md` (the two tiers, the write path, the one-writer rule, the index rebuild), refresh `architecture/overview.md`'s "the board is the only state" section to "the store is the only state", and a CHANGELOG entry.
4. Run `npm run lint && npm test && npm run smoke`.

## Done when
- [ ] `npm test` green, `npm run smoke` green (the tarball on Node 22 and 24).
- [ ] The scratch-repo walk-through above is recorded in this card's result with the exact commands.
- [ ] `docs/wiki/concepts/store.md` exists, `architecture/overview.md` is refreshed, `node .repolore/scripts/wiki-check.mjs` reports nothing stale for the pages this track touched.
- [ ] The track's summary names, per child, what landed and what is open.

**Read first:** `docs/local-first.md` (the plan; the sections named below), `docs/wiki/decisions/adr-005-control-plane.md`,
`docs/wiki/decisions/adr-006-local-store.md`, `CLAUDE.md`. Keep it dependency-free at runtime. Pure logic in
`src/model.js` with a test. Errors name the fix and carry `.exitCode`. `--json` everywhere. Update the wiki page a
change touches (`node .repolore/scripts/wiki-check.mjs` lists what went stale); a new feature gets a new page.
Finish with `npm run lint && npm test` green, one draft PR, and exactly one terminal verb.
goal: test/store.test.js green on the github and local drivers; a scratch repo initialised on the local store runs create → claim → finish → serve end to end; docs and wiki updated
title: Local-first hkb, track A: the Node floor, no Actions, the store seam, the two-tier store
